canonical_project: Pi Datacenters Amaravati/Vijayawada, IT Park Mangalagiri
notes: Pi's official site describes the Amaravati (Vijayawada) hyperscale DC as flagship hub with up to 5,000 racks / 60 MW capacity; facility at Survey 49/P, Plot 12, IT Park, Mangalagiri, Guntur district. DataCenterMap currently lists ~3 MW operating; 60 MW is marketed campus capacity. Inaugurated by CM in 2017 (Rs 600 cr investment).
